protocol.heldout_scope: Only the selected learning rate is evaluated on held-out paths. Selection never uses these losses.
protocol.near5_scope: The 5% interval uses the independent selection profile, not held-out losses.
protocol.random_generator: numpy.default_rng / PCG64, float64 standard_normal; shared across all candidates and CNRs
protocol.arithmetic: C++17 double; compiler -O3 -ffp-contract=off; 12 independent CNR workers
protocol.fit: OLS log(eta) against log(B) on the original nine power-of-two batches. Original paper exponents are unchanged.
protocol.display: Slider snaps to one of 22 actually tuned CNR conditions; all 16 batch points are shown. No CNR interpolation.

scope: Supplemental toy-model computations for this playable, alongside 27 unchanged paper measurements. Not language-model runs.
